title: tricholaena repens var. rosea
intro: Tricholaena repens var. rosea, commonly known as Red Tricholaena, is a type of grass found in various parts of the world. It is used in traditional medicine for its multiple health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, treating fever, and aiding in digestion. The therapeutic actions of Red Tricholaena include its anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and carminative properties, making it effective in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
